notes.title: Welcome to Wizard's Warp
notes.content:
Hi! We are pleased to introduce you to a new game! 🧙‍♂️

If you haven't seen the trailer yet, you can watch it here:

[previewyoutube=VovK6idRJPI;full][/previewyoutube]

An exciting and hardcore😈 challenge awaits you, feel like a real wizard and master the skill of teleportation to perfection!

Will you be able to save your favorite pet? Or will you be unable to withstand the heat of fireballs? We'll find out soon enough!

If you find the game interesting, please add it to your Wishlist😇

Thanks for staying with us🥰
